title: Desert Canyon Drawing
description: A person sees a black and white ink drawing of rocky mesas and buttes rising above rolling desert hills. In the foreground are clumps of desert grasses and shrubs, with the ground showing faint paths winding between the formations under a large empty white sky.
prompt: black and white ink drawing of a desert scene with tall rocky mesas and buttes in the background, rolling hills and valleys in the middle ground, and clumps of desert grass and shrubs in the foreground, large empty white sky above, detailed line work with heavy black shading on the rock faces, simple and stark western scenery
